It also owns the synthesis issue gloss: tracker ID, one-sentence plain-English description and unlock-chain consequence, plus the humanisation rule and banned project-management shorthand. Do not extend its catalogue inline. **Universal-routing rule:** every terminal output, tracker description and tracker comment passes through the configured adaptor's normalise pass before printing/writing. Only skill source (`skills/*/SKILL.md`) and internal `.faff/` logs are exempt. Each skill applies this final pass at every emit/write site; there is no central emit function. Raw, un-normalised descriptions/comments are non-conformant.
